name: Museum of Science and Industry
tagline: Chicago MSI — U-505 submarine, Science Storms, and kid hands-on overload (in a good way).

practical.ticket_note: Timed entry common; parking garage on site.
practical.best_start: One icon (U-505 or Science Storms) + one hands-on zone.

do_not_list.name: Creative Makery
do_not_list.reason: Use Idea Factory for little-kid make/play.

do_not_list.name: Dinosaur hall
do_not_list.reason: Not MSI’s icon — Field Museum is Chicago’s dino destination.

do_not_list.name: Space shuttle / orbiter
do_not_list.reason: No orbiter at MSI; U-505 is the iconic vessel.

items.label: U-505 Submarine
items.one_liner: A captured WWII U-boat — walk around a real submarine.

qa_card.question: What surprised you about the submarine’s size?

items.label: Science Storms
items.one_liner: Tsunami tank, avalanche, and storm science you can feel.

qa_card.question: Which storm demo was loudest or splashiest?
qa_card.answer: Wave, wind, or avalanche — pick one!

items.label: Henry Crown Space Center
items.one_liner: Rockets, spaceflight stories, and big sky dreams.

qa_card.question: What would you pack for a trip to space?
qa_card.answer: Food, tools, or a toy — one idea!

qa_card.question: What did you build or knock down?

items.label: The Great Train Story
items.one_liner: A giant model train layout across America.

qa_card.question: Which train or town did you spot first?
qa_card.answer: Color, mountain, or city — one find!

items.label: Colleen Moore's Fairy Castle
items.one_liner: A tiny fairy palace with jewel-box rooms.

qa_card.question: What tiny detail was your favorite?

items.label: Take Flight
items.one_liner: Stand under a real Boeing 727 — look up!

qa_card.question: How big did the plane feel from underneath?
qa_card.answer: Wings, wheels, or engines — one word!

items.label: Free explore
items.one_liner: Their choice hall — follow what pulls them in.

qa_card.question: What pulled you into the next room?

research_notes: Rewrote 2026-08-08 from Griffin MSI icons (U-505, Science Storms, Henry Crown Space, Idea Factory, trains, fairy castle, Take Flight). Removed generic CM/sci taxonomy leakage.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Griffin MSI bonus · U-505 + Storms + Fairy Castle

challenges.text: U-505: walk the length once — longer or shorter than you guessed?
Science Storms: which demo is loudest right now?
Great Train Story: find a mountain and a city on the layout
Fairy Castle: tiniest furniture detail you can name
Take Flight: stand under the 727 — wings or landing gear first impression?
Henry Crown Space Center: one object that went beyond Earth (or looks like it)

bonus_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find a “Griffin MSI” or museum map — point to a hall you haven’t entered
bonus_hunt.easter_egg_little: ★ Easter egg: Idea Factory only after U-505 or Storms
sources: U-505, Science Storms, Great Train Story, Fairy Castle, Take Flight
